values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/longlakemissaukee ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Long Lake State Forest Campground, Missaukee: 11 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat ramp to Long Lake inside the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/longlakemissaukee ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'Ramp access for Long Lake is located within the campground.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/longlakemissaukee ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (Long Lake, Missaukee: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 'Eleven sites are available for tents and small trailers' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/longlakemissaukee ('Eleven sites are available for tents and small trailers.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site.') + amenity table (11 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground perched on a hill overlooking Long Lake, 3.5 mi NW of Lake City (Missaukee County); the access road runs through Goose Lake State Forest Campground. Managed by Mitchell State Park. Pike, bass and panfish in the lake. Small sites — confirm a 23-ft rig fits before relying on it. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 11 sites for tents and small trailers (count confirmed; length silent), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (inherited max now confirmed). Season (open all year; winter may be park and walk in) already manual and matches the table. Boat ramp in the campground. Type 'rustic', ORV operation to trails 'no'. Note trimmed of field restatements.
